headline: This law requires that commercial truck or bus drivers who use a commercial vehicle to commit a serious human trafficking felony be permanently barred from driving one.
what_it_does: The law directs the Department of Transportation to disqualify a person for life from operating a commercial motor vehicle if that person uses the vehicle while committing a felony involving a severe form of human trafficking. A commercial motor vehicle is a larger vehicle used for business, such as a tractor-trailer or a passenger bus. The summary provided does not describe any additional details about how the disqualification is carried out.

who_it_affects.how: A driver who is convicted of a severe human trafficking felony committed while using a commercial vehicle would lose the right to operate such vehicles for life.
These companies would no longer be able to employ a driver who has been permanently disqualified under this law to operate their commercial vehicles.
